figures.name: Durga

ability.name: Lion Ride
ability.description: Destroy one demon enemy permanently; all allies gain +3 power from divine victory.

figures.description: The great warrior goddess riding a lion who slays Mahishasura with ten arms bearing ten divine weapons.

figures.name: Kali (Bengali)

ability.name: Blood Tongue
ability.description: This card cannot be stopped once activated; deal 5 damage to all enemies and drain their power.

figures.description: The fierce black goddess of Bengal who fights in a cremation ground frenzy, adorned with skulls and blood.

figures.name: Manasa

ability.name: Snake Queen's Wrath
ability.description: Inflict snake venom on one enemy and two adjacent enemies; all serpent allies gain +2.

figures.description: The uniquely Bengali serpent goddess who competes with Shiva for devotion and rules over snakebite and fertility.

figures.name: Saraswati (Bengali)

ability.name: Vidya Blessing
ability.description: Grant all allies +3 wisdom; all knowledge-based abilities gain +3 power.

figures.description: The goddess of knowledge and arts whose Bengali spring festival draws students to seek her blessing.

figures.name: Jagaddhatri

ability.name: World Sustainer
ability.description: This card cannot be debuffed or disrupted while it remains in play.

figures.description: The World-Sustaining goddess uniquely beloved in Bengali tradition who rides a lion and holds the world in balance.

figures.name: Lakshmi (Bengali)

ability.name: Autumn Wealth
ability.description: Restore 3 HP and grant +2 to all stats; all harvest and nature allies gain additional +1.

figures.description: The Bengali autumn Lakshmi Puja celebrates the goddess arriving on her owl to bless the harvest season.

figures.name: Kartik (Bengali)

ability.name: Bengali Warrior
ability.description: All Bengali warrior allies gain +2 power for 1 turn.

figures.description: The Bengali form of Kartikeya worshipped as the ideal of beautiful divine youth in the autumn festival.

figures.name: Bishahari

ability.name: Serpent Blessing
ability.description: All snake and water allies gain +2 defense for 1 turn.

figures.description: The southern Bengali serpent goddess Bishahari who governs snakebite and the protection of rural communities.

figures.name: Annada

ability.name: Food Giver
ability.description: Restore 4 HP to one ally and 2 HP to all others from divine nourishment.

figures.description: The Bengali food-giving goddess Annada who ensures no devotee goes hungry and governs all nourishment.

figures.name: Sitala

ability.name: Cooling Touch
ability.description: Remove all fever and disease effects from allies; inflict disease on one enemy.

figures.description: The donkey-riding Bengali goddess who both sends and cures smallpox — propitiated to prevent childhood illness.

figures.name: Dakshina Raya

ability.name: Sundarbans Lord
ability.description: Tiger allies gain +4 power; this card cannot be attacked by nature or forest enemies.

figures.description: The tiger lord of the Sundarbans delta worshipped as a fierce god who must be appeased by fishermen and woodcutters.

figures.name: Dharmaraj

ability.name: Dharma's Book
ability.description: Record one enemy's every action; at battle's end deal accumulated damage.

figures.description: The Bengali judge of the dead who records all deeds in his divine ledger — distinct from pan-Indian Yama.

figures.name: Muktakeshi

ability.name: Tantric Power
ability.description: Activate a forbidden ability: deal 5 magic damage that bypasses all defenses.

figures.description: The loose-haired tantric form of the goddess worshipped at midnight with forbidden rites in Bengal.

figures.name: Chhaya

ability.name: Shadow Twin
ability.description: Create a shadow duplicate of one ally; the duplicate draws all attacks for 1 turn.

figures.description: The shadow woman who replaced Surya's wife Sanjna, whose children by the sun include Shani (Saturn).

figures.name: Shani

ability.name: Saturn's Lesson
ability.description: Reduce one enemy's speed by 3 permanently from the slow weight of karmic consequence.

figures.description: The limping god of Saturn and karmic retribution whose gaze brings misfortune that ultimately teaches wisdom.

figures.name: Pakshiraj

ability.name: Winged Sprint
ability.description: Move to any position; deal 3 damage from aerial speed.

figures.description: The winged horse of Bengali heroic folklore who carries heroes on impossible journeys across the sky.

figures.name: Thakurmar Jhuli Spirit

ability.name: Folk Tale
ability.description: Reveal one secret: expose the most dangerous enemy hidden ability.

figures.description: The spirit of Bengali folk tales and the wondrous creatures that inhabit the grandmother's story basket.

figures.name: Chandi

ability.name: Battle Cry
ability.description: Deal 4 damage to all enemies; all dark-aligned allies gain +2 power.

figures.description: The fierce battle form of the goddess celebrated in the Bengali Chandi Mangal texts of medieval literature.

figures.name: Nishumbha

ability.name: Dark General
ability.description: All dark-aligned allies gain +2 power when this card enters play.

figures.description: The great demon general defeated by Durga in the cosmic battle described in the Devi Mahatmya.

figures.name: Raktabija

ability.name: Blood Seed
ability.description: When this card takes damage, create one copy with 4/4/4/4/4 stats for each 2 damage taken.

figures.description: The demon whose every drop of blood creates a new demon — Kali defeated him by drinking all the blood.
